ideas.pitch: A text-to-SQL application that converts natural language queries directly into complex IBM Db2 queries, instantly executing them and generating visual data dashboards on the fly.
ideas.problem_statement: Text-to-SQL applications and AI-powered data analytics
ideas.title: Db2Text2Dash: Natural Language to Enterprise SQL and Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the text-to-SQL and data analytics suggested directions while echoing the live demo success and API orchestration of past winners like the Tableau DataDev project.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent document processing and semantic search platform that ingests messy enterprise PDFs, extracts structured tables into IBM Db2, and powers a context-aware RAG search engine.
ideas.problem_statement: Document intelligence systems and AI-powered RAG applications
ideas.title: Db2DocIntel: Enterprise Document Intelligence & Semantic Vault
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines vector search with structured relational storage in IBM Db2, fulfilling the document intelligence track requirement with a clear, demonstrable workflow.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent system powered by CrewAI that continuously inspects database performance, checks for anomalies in IBM Db2 logs, and autonomously generates optimization queries.
ideas.problem_statement: Intelligent AI agents and AI-powered data analytics
ideas.title: Db2AgentOps: Autonomous Multi-Agent Database Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent coordination frameworks like CrewAI, mirroring the autonomous diagnostic success seen in recent multi-agent hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An automated data profiling and validation tool that inspects tables in IBM Db2 for data integrity issues, schema inconsistencies, and demographic biases in stored records.
ideas.problem_statement: AI-powered data analytics and semantic search
ideas.title: Db2SchemaGuard: Automated Database Bias & Data Integrity Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines automated data profiling with database inspection, drawing directly from the data profiling and bias detection patterns of recent runner-up and winning projects.

ideas.pitch: A conversational AI assistant that acts as a digital twin for corporate operations, maintaining long-term conversational memory and operational state inside IBM Db2 vector tables.
ideas.problem_statement: Database-powered chatbots and semantic search and vector search
ideas.title: Db2TwinChat: Enterprise Digital Twin Chatbot with Vector Memory
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly implements vector search capabilities with IBM Db2, offering a highly polished conversational interface that appeals to judges looking for practical enterprise utilities.
